notes.title: Patch 1.4 Live
notes.content:
Hi chooms!!

Hope you are well and enjoying your day!

We are delighted to inform you that patch 1.4  is now live! The patch fixes some minor bug, and also balance the difficulty of some level. In particular, level 5 is now less hard to complete.

We hope you are enjoying playing our game, and thank you for your continue support!


Your fellow gamedev,

Stefano & Fabio

notes.title: Patch 1.3.6 live now! Catalan language and more!
notes.content:
Hi chooms! 

We inform you that we just released a new patch (build 1.3.6) for the game!

Here are the main features added and fixes:


 Added Catalan as playable language for the game! Hola amics!
 Fixed a bug in the highway chase levels for the cat bomb: now it's easier to destroy enemy cars.
 Fixed difficulty of some game level, especially the last one (now easier)
 Improved global performance of the game 
 Small fixes on texts and other minor bugs



Should you find any bugs, do not hesitate to contact us or to write on the official discussion!

As always, thank you for your support! We hope you'll have a good time in Death Noodle Delivery!

Yours fellow gamedevs,

Stefano & Fabio

notes.title: Death Noodle Delivery is OUT NOW!!
notes.content:
Hi everyone, 

Today is the day!

Death Noodle Delivery is officially available for purchase right here on Steam!

This is our first project as two solo-developers (Tiny Pixel and Stupidi Pixel) who have joined forces to make projects that we love, and that we hope you will play and enjoy. 

Death Noodle Delivery is an often surreal and gritty, cyberpunk narrative-action game which imagines the life of a food delivery driver in a dark futuristic world, where society is on the brink of collapse, a new crisis happens every day, and where dangers lurk in every corner. 

You’ll take on the role of Jimmy as he starts his new job, delivering noodles for a big corporation that pays you only if you survive. Most citizens in this city spend their entire lives looking to earn cash and seeking leisure within the walls of their apartments, connected to cyberspace, seeking to quench their thirst in all kinds of pleasures, from Sex AIs to very strong drugs, Jimmy’s world is not for those who love sunflowers and rainbows!

Key Features:

Ride through a cyberpunk city on the brink of collapse:
Deliver your boss’ noodles escaping dangers like AI drones and bad drivers
Learn the best tactics to survive each delivery ride and get home in one piece

Upgrade your hoverboard from a rusty ironing board to a powerful machine:
Jailbreak AI to unlock new power-ups
Utilize AI simulations to practice deliveries and test new board features

Interact with neighbors to uncover their hidden stories:
Meet the folks living in your apartment and form relationships
Explore the web for hacks and pleasures

The game is available for purchase today for the price of $4.99 on Steam for PC with a discount of 15%, so grab it right now!

 The OST DLC will launch a little later for $1.99. 

If you are also a console player, or know someone with a Nintendo Switch, Xbox or PlayStation who might enjoy Death Noodle Delivery, it will come to those consoles very soon!

Thank you for stopping by. 

If you would like to join us in further discussion, want to tell us your deepest AI-xieties, or drop us a follow, just write us here on our pages on social platforms!

Thank you for your support!!

Stefano & Fabio

Stay ready for some cyberpunk, captivating and strange adventures!!

Yours fellow gamedev,

Stefano & Fabio

notes.title: Development News and special Thanks
notes.content:
Hey Chooms!

First of all: Thank you to all of you for wishlisting the game! Since Steam Next Fest we have been busy in the development of the game and participating to conventions to  show the game.

Right now, we are working on a new scenario for the game! After a hard day of noodle deliveries, our protagonist Jimmy just want to rest, but unfortunately he will have to face a crowded highway to get home. Furthermore, a certain pizza chef will be anything but happy that his potential customers are being stolen...

Want a sneak peak? Here it is!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42582289/da688cff99484b5ee04abf4223a040f68091dbd8.gif


Apart from that, we are working on all the narrative parts and the localizations! We can already tell you that the game will be released in other languages other than english: stay connected for more information very soon!

Again, we'd like to thank you for your support: we'll do our best to deliver the best game we can!

Your friendly gamedevs,

Stefano & Fabio
